_about: THE ALOE (Aloe vera and its kin): a stemless rosette of thick, fleshy, channelled leaves, grey-green flecked with pale spots, small teeth along their edges; from it a tall stalk with a spike of tubular flowers, yellow or coral. Its LOOK, painted into the flowers' atlas (plants/flowers.js): petal / petal2 / centre / leaf / spike -- shape, colours (a list: one a variant), throat, veins and touches. How it GROWS -- stem, leaves, blooms and their sizes -- is its recipe in plants/flowers.js (GROW).
